rootCause: Runtime country features omitted the country display name, so country.renamed advanced the world/controller revision while structurally reusing countries-low and countries-high features; no property-only updateData diff existed.

WorldMap allowed verification for different revisions to overlap, and an older verification's finally handler could clear the sentinel for a newer verification. Rapid commit/undo/redo therefore lacked a single ordered latest-revision verification schedule.

The MapLibre error handler treated any post-load non-runtime error occurring while map.loaded() was temporarily false as a fatal world-source error. Fatal classification is now limited to the four runtime sources, while pre-style errors remain initial-load failures.

historicalFailureScope.note: The missing rename property affected both country sources; border data was unchanged. The previous E2E did not persist the historical controller snapshot/sourceId, so the old screenshot alone cannot identify a narrower emitted source. The repaired run verifies every source explicitly.

fixes: Added displayName to runtime country features and change detection, producing updateData property diffs without geometry replacement.
Serialized idle verification and discarded stale revision results without setting resyncRequired; a new render schedules the latest revision.
Stopped unrelated post-load MapLibre errors from changing the world map status.
Added debug accessors for world/projection revisions, source identities, displayName, and source feature revisions.
Strengthened deterministic E2E and regenerated/inspected all six visual artifacts.

incrementalEvidence.fullSetData: initial source load, source recreation, or explicit manual resynchronization only
incrementalEvidence.propertyOnlyDiff: FRA territory IDs only; newGeometry absent; removeAllProperties plus addOrUpdateProperties includes displayName

sourceVerification.countries-low: features present, revision matched, FRA name matched
sourceVerification.countries-high: features present, revision matched, FRA name matched

knownLimitations: The reserved war source remains intentionally empty until an authoritative war-data port is connected.
